subject.title: [Bug]: Real-time logs of openclaw cron jobs are not displayed in the chat session of the webui

question: Where should live progress for isolated cron runs be shown in the Web UI?
rationale: The source path is clear, but automatically mirroring background cron activity into the watched chat would change the product contract for isolated cron sessions and may create cross-session noise.

options.title: Run-scoped follow surface
options.body: Keep cron output attached to the run-scoped cron chat or an explicit follow/watch surface, and make live progress visible there without surprising other selected chats.

options.title: Mirror into origin chat
options.body: Stream cron progress into the originating or watched chat, accepting a broader routing contract and background progress in normal chat history.

options.title: Final-only delivery
options.body: Document final delivery plus run-history polling as intended and close the live Web UI streaming request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Run-scoped follow surface
recommendation.body: Keep cron output attached to the run-scoped cron chat or an explicit follow/watch surface, and make live progress visible there without surprising other selected chats.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has both isolated-cron feature history and recent Cron Jobs UI ownership signals, making him the best routing candidate for the UX contract choice.
